description: Derived from AGSC-01-14: every `.md` file MUST be UTF-8 without a byte-order mark, use LF line endings, be NFC-normalized and end with exactly one LF, and a `.md` file MUST NOT contain a C0 control character other than U+0009 and U+000A; each fault is AGSC-E108, which section 9.4 registers as an error (it is a warning only when `lint --fix` reports a normalisation it applied, AGSC-04-19, a case `lint-0026` covers). Over the minimal fixture, whose lint reports nothing, five concept files are added, each conforming in every key and a member of the fixture's cluster, and each carrying exactly one of the five faults: a leading U+FEFF (bom.md), CRLF line endings (crlf.md), a title written as `e` followed by U+0301 COMBINING ACUTE ACCENT, whose NFC form is U+00E9 (nfd.md), no LF after the last line (nolf.md), and U+0007 in the body (ctrl.md). The whole list `lint` reports is five AGSC-E108 errors, one naming each file, and lint exits 1. The vector itself stays NFC and ASCII: each fault is written as a JSON escape.
